first_acquisition.why: Claude Code's auto-mode permission classifier denied the command with the reason '[Auto-Mode Bypass]' before it ran. The executor did not run it any other way. No SEC request has been sent under this approval; the ledger root has no slot

exposure_while_paused: the start record lives only in this container. If the container is lost before a capture and an export, the marker on issue 47 stays, and a new start is refused by design (ISSUE_47_SEC_LEDGER_STARTED_ELSEWHERE); nothing was spent, and resuming from there is the owner's decision

first_acquisition_after_permission.cli_defect: after the capture and its checkpoint were registered, the command crashed writing its run summary beside the ledger: the summary's cumulative block carries request_digests as a set, which json cannot serialize, and the file had been opened before serialization, so runs/20260929T083744Z.json is left truncated at 944 bytes. The summary is the CLI's own convenience record: the export takes the slots, the claim log, the binding, the attribution and the checkpoint, not runs/, so nothing the ledger holds is affected. The truncated file is left as it was written
